appamajjana.p: [Na+pamajjana] (na) CL=9 not forgetting. See Appamāda - (2).
a: အပ္ပမဇ္ဇန(န)

K:
appamajjana：＂အပ္ပမဇ္ဇန（န）
[န+ပမဇ္ဇန]
မမေ့မလျော့ခြင်း။ အပ္ပမာဒ-（၂）-ကြည့်။
DOP: pamajjanā f. , pamajjana, n. [ from pamajjati 1 ], carelessness, heedlessness, remissness; Nidd I 423, 25 (yo evarūpo pamādo ~ā pamajjitattaṃ) = Vibh 350, 28 ; Th-a III 90, 9 (pamādan ti ~aṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ananuṭṭhānaṃ akusalaṃ ca dhammesu cittavossaggo); Vibh-a 499, 22 (pamajjanavasena pamattabhāvo pamādo ti veditabbo); — appamajjana , n. , care; assiduousness; Pj I 142, 14 (~aṃ appamādo); It-a I 170, 2 (samathavipassanābhāvanāya ~e ratā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr appamajjena).
CPD: a-ppamajjana , n. ( neg. verbal noun of do. ) ; ~aṃ, Pj l 142, 14 (— 'appamādo'); ~aṃ satiyā avippavāso, Nidd-a ( E e ) l 188, 28 ( E e na ppa°; = 'appamādo'); dānâdipuñña-kiriyāsu ~am, lt-a ( E e ) 81, 8 ( ad lt 16, 17 *); loc. ~e ratā(= 'appamāda-ratā'), lt-a ( E e ) 170, 2 ( misprint appamajjena).
